title: Ask what something is called or what a word means
can_do: Can ask what a thing is called, what a word means or how to say something, and point to what they want.

title: Understand spoken numbers, prices and times
can_do: Can catch numbers, prices and clock times said aloud at normal-slow speed, face to face or over a loudspeaker.

title: Keep a conversation going when you don't understand
uk_example: Вибачте, я не зрозумів / не зрозуміла.
can_do: Can show they did not understand and ask the other person to repeat, slow down or spell a word.

title: Read public signs and notices
can_do: Can understand common signs and short notices: entrance, exit, open, closed, push, pull, no smoking, break times.

title: Ask and tell the time, day and date
can_do: Can ask and say what time it is, on which day or date something happens, and use today, tomorrow, yesterday.

title: Leave a short note
uk_example: Я в магазині. Буду о п'ятій.
can_do: Can leave a note saying where they have gone and when they will be back.

title: Talk about your daily routine
can_do: Can say what they do on a normal day, on a workday and at the weekend, and when.

title: Follow instructions in a language lesson
can_do: Can follow the teacher's simple instructions: read, repeat, open the book, listen, write.

title: Order in a cafe or restaurant
can_do: Can order food and drink, ask what a dish is, handle 'we're out of that', ask for the bill and pay.

title: Read a menu
can_do: Can read a simple menu with its sections, dishes and prices.

title: Read an event poster or programme
can_do: Can find what is on, when, where and how much on a poster, programme or leaflet.

title: Talk about free time and likes
uk_example: Що ти любиш робити у вільний час?
can_do: Can say what they like and dislike doing, how often, and ask the other person.

title: Write about your hobbies and likes
can_do: Can write a short post or message about their hobbies, likes and dislikes.

title: Get the topic of a news item or advert
uk_example: (topic recognition only: sport, weather, politics, advert for a product)
can_do: Can tell what a short news item or advert is about, helped by pictures.

title: Read a short illustrated text
uk_example: Сьогодні неділя. Марко й Оля йдуть у парк.
can_do: Can follow a short illustrated story or news snippet written in very simple language.

title: Follow a guided tour
can_do: Can follow very simple information on a guided tour: what a building is, how old, who lived there.

title: Tell a doctor what the problem is
can_do: Can say what hurts, since when, and answer simple questions from a doctor.

title: Ask for urgent help
can_do: Can call for help, say what happened in a few words and say where they are.

title: Get something at a pharmacy
can_do: Can describe a simple problem, ask for something against it and understand how often to take it.

title: Talk about where you live
uk_example: Я живу в місті …, недалеко від центру.
can_do: Can say and ask about the city and area they live in and describe their home and rooms simply.

title: Give your personal details when asked
can_do: Can give name (and spell it), address, phone number, nationality and date of birth when asked slowly.

title: Fill in a simple form
can_do: Can fill in a simple paper or online form (registration, order) with personal details, dates and numbers.

title: Introduce yourself and get to know someone
uk_example: Мене звати … А вас? / А тебе?
can_do: Can say and ask name, where they are from, where they live, what they do and which languages they speak.

title: Give a short self-introduction to a group
can_do: Can give a short prepared introduction of themselves to a group: name, origin, home, work, likes.

title: Introduce yourself in a message
can_do: Can write a short message introducing themselves to someone new and ask one or two questions back.

title: Greet, thank, apologise and say goodbye
can_do: Can greet, ask how someone is and react, thank, apologise and take leave, choosing formal or informal address.

title: Talk about your family
uk_example: У мене є брат і сестра.
can_do: Can say who is in their family (and pets), their names, ages and jobs, and ask about the other person's.

title: Describe a family photo
uk_example: Це моя мама, а це мій тато.
can_do: Can show a photo and say who is who, where they stand and what they look like.

title: Visit or host friends at home
can_do: As guest or host: welcome, offer and accept food and drink, hand over a gift, pay a compliment, thank and leave.

title: Find each other at a meeting point by message
uk_example: Я вже на вокзалі, біля каси.
can_do: Can text where they are, what they are wearing, or that they are running late, and understand the same.

title: React to friends' posts
can_do: Can react to posts with short comments and reply to comments with thanks or an apology.

title: Make plans with a friend
can_do: Can invite someone, accept or decline, and agree on day, time and place to meet.

title: Make plans by text message
can_do: Can read and write short messages proposing, accepting or declining a meeting and confirming time and place.

title: Propose a short toast
can_do: Can propose a very short, rehearsed toast at a meal or celebration.

title: Understand a friend's voice message
can_do: Can get who, what, when and where from a short, clear voice message.

title: Write birthday and holiday wishes
can_do: Can write short congratulations and wishes for a birthday or a holiday.

title: Exchange money and ask about payment
can_do: Can ask where to exchange money, ask the rate, say how much, and ask whether card or cash.

title: Buy food and everyday items
uk_example: Дайте, будь ласка, хліб і кілограм яблук.
can_do: Can say what and how much they want, ask the price, and pay, in a shop or at a market.

title: Buy clothes
can_do: Can ask for a size and colour, ask to try something on, and say it is too big or small.

title: Read store information
can_do: Can read store guides, price tags, offers and opening hours.

title: Understand station announcements
uk_example: Потяг Київ — Львів відправляється з другої колії о дев'ятій двадцять.
can_do: Can catch train, platform, time and delay in a slow, clear announcement.

title: Answer questions at passport control
uk_example: Мета вашого візиту? — Туризм. / В гості до друзів.
can_do: Can answer simple questions about purpose and length of stay and where they will stay.

title: Follow written directions
can_do: Can follow short written directions, e.g. a friend's message on how to get to their flat, or signs inside a building.

title: Ask for and understand directions
can_do: Can ask where something is and follow short, simple directions to a nearby place.

title: Read accommodation information
can_do: Can read basic accommodation information: meal times, Wi-Fi, check-out, house rules.

title: Check in at a hotel or guesthouse
can_do: Can check in, give details, and ask about breakfast time, Wi-Fi and check-out.

title: Send a postcard or message from a trip
can_do: Can write a short postcard or message saying where they are, what it is like and what they do.

title: Take a taxi
uk_example: На вулицю Хрещатик, десять, будь ласка.
can_do: Can give an address, ask the price, ask to stop, and pay.

title: Buy a train or bus ticket
uk_example: Один квиток до Львова, будь ласка.
can_do: Can buy a ticket, say where and when to, and ask about departure time and platform.

title: Read timetables and departure boards
can_do: Can read departure and arrival times, platforms, delays and cancellations.

title: Read a weather forecast
can_do: Can read a simple forecast with temperatures and symbols.

title: Talk about the weather
can_do: Can say and ask what the weather is like today and tomorrow.
